subject.title: Bug: 升级后 Dashboard 历史会话索引/映射错乱

question: Should OpenClaw add a doctor/diagnostic repair that can relink a Dashboard session key to an orphaned transcript or trajectory, and what evidence is sufficient to choose the target?
rationale: Relinking persisted history is a product and data-integrity choice because the code can detect candidate files, but only maintainer policy can decide when the evidence is strong enough to rewrite user history indexes.

options.title: Fixture-backed doctor repair
options.body: Require a redacted fixture and implement a guarded doctor repair that checks session store metadata, transcript headers, trajectory references, and content evidence before relinking, refusing ambiguous cases.

options.title: Read-only diagnostics only
options.body: Add warnings/export guidance for orphaned or mismapped histories but do not automatically relink any stored Dashboard key.

options.title: Wait for transcript identity
options.body: Defer repair until transcript headers persist `sessionKey` or equivalent identity, then build recovery on that stronger signal.

recommendation.title: Fixture-backed doctor repair
recommendation.body: Require a redacted fixture and implement a guarded doctor repair that checks session store metadata, transcript headers, trajectory references, and content evidence before relinking, refusing ambiguous cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on transcript read identity and session accessor boundaries makes this the closest available owner signal for the policy choice.
